gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-comme: A wide-mouthed lowercase a gives Conthrax its look, its strokes pressed at a fixed stylus pressure and reading like a single thread. Comme reads smooth, no clogged curves, lowercase filling most of the height.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-cossette-texte: Conthrax is geometric and clean, with capitals barely taller than its lowercase. Cossette Texte follows with a prominent x-height and wide-eyed e, so the two sit together on the page easily.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-duru-sans: Sleek, tubular, unmistakably geometric: Conthrax cuts every stem and curve from one gauge of tubing. Duru Sans lets small letters open wide, their bodies dominating the line while ascenders hardly show.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-fresca: Conthrax brings a wide-mouthed lowercase a and bodies so tall its capitals barely stand out. But Fresca stays open, with no calligraphic thinning and short ascenders above its big bowls.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-funnel-sans: Lowercase bodies so tall that capitals barely rise above them mark Conthrax, a geometric display face. Funnel Sans then reads steadily, its stroke widths holding from stem to curve.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-gafata: Neon-glass thickness runs through Conthrax, a geometric display face whose lowercase is so tall the capitals barely rise above it. Gafata sets that heavy tubing against a lighter, tall-banded body.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-geist: Clean first: Conthrax is geometric, with a wide-mouthed lowercase a. Geist lays down a quiet, level sans-serif beat, and its words read as solid blocks rather than skylines, line after line.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-georama: Conthrax locks its stems and arcs in step, with a wide-mouthed lowercase a and capitals barely taller than the rest. Georama then reads approachably, its c pulled wide and its capitals barely rising.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-gidole: The body text reads like neon tubing, every stroke uniform and the terminals parted like open scissor blades. Gidole, a clean sans-serif with a high-set midline, keeps paragraphs moving at a steady pace under Conthrax.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-golos-text: Geometric Conthrax has a wide-mouthed lowercase a and bodies so tall the capitals barely rise above them. And Golos Text fills the line with its x-height, a widely parted s and a single stroke width.
